contributions.claim: NU.nl reports all people still aboard Hondius at Rotterdam arrival tested negative for hantavirus and had no symptoms.
contributions.uncertainty: Limited to those remaining on ship at Rotterdam, not all previous passengers or all prior cases.

relations.reason: Earlier cruise ship is unnamed in visible excerpts; common hantavirus/cruise topic suggests linkage but does not prove identity.

delta_expectations.reason: New named-ship testing result materially informs that ship's health status; cannot erase prior deaths or close all outbreak questions.

ambiguity_notes: Publication-order simulation: authentic availability unknown. Negative remaining-passenger tests do not imply no earlier infections.
